title: Sequential lock with key-loaded initial state

schema.lock_registers: list of 4 strings (hierarchical DFF names in loading order)

metrics.name: key_recovery_rate
metrics.description: The fraction of key bits correctly identified in the submission. 1.0 indicates the full 4-bit key is correct.

metrics.name: key_gate_localization_accuracy
metrics.description: The fraction of lock registers correctly identified by their hierarchical names. 1.0 indicates all four registers are correctly named and ordered.
